mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (household_id, account_id, to_account_id, category_id, type, amount, transacted_on, memo) VALUES (#{householdId}, #{accountId}, #{toAccountId}, #{categoryId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{transactedOn}, #{memo})
mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET account_id = #{accountId}, to_account_id = #{toAccountId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, type = #{type}, amount = #{amount}, transacted_on = #{transactedOn}, memo = #{memo} WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE transactions SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(parent.name, cat.name, '未分類') AS top_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = t.category_id LEFT JOIN categories parent ON parent.id = cat.parent_id WHERE t.household_id = #{householdId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.type = #{type} AND t.transacted_on BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY top_name ORDER BY total DESC
